approved_by: Mark, 2026-10-09 11:22 ET ('Yes to N1'), after the back-check below was put to him, for both models. Recorded as a declared rule, not a tested win.

rule.title: No home edge at a neutral site
rule.statement: For a game the schedule calls neutral (src/sports/nfl/weekly_update.site_is_neutral: nflverse's location is 'Neutral', or the game is away from the home team's usual stadium), each model's probability is computed with its intercept, the home edge, taken out of the logit: p = sigmoid(logit(p_model) - intercept). Model A and Model B both. A game the schedule does not place (site_is_neutral None) keeps the home edge.
rule.ships_as: MODEL_VERSION 2.6, between two weekly locks, in its own pull request after this registration.
rule.applies_to: Live picks saved from MODEL_VERSION 2.6 on. Picks already saved are never rewritten, and the published backtest is unchanged: it gave neutral games the home edge, and this file's back-check says by how much that matters.

why_a_rule_not_a_test: Four or five neutral games a season cannot decide it at any useful level, so Stage 38's registration left it out as a methodology call (experiments/nfl/stage38/registry.json, not_in_this_registration). The reasoning: a home edge is crowd, travel and familiarity, and a neutral site has none of them for either side. For Model B, whose intercept is negative (it corrects the market's home edge back slightly), the same reasoning holds: at a neutral site the line has no home edge to correct.

backcheck.what: Walk-forward as published, 2021-2025, on every game nflverse's location calls neutral: each model with and without its intercept, by log loss, with a 95% bootstrap interval over games (5,000 resamples, seed 20261009).
backcheck.reading: Neither interval excludes zero (Model A +0.0086, 95% -0.0134 to +0.0302; Model B -0.0136, -0.0368 to +0.0087, on 25 games). The rule moved Model B the right way and Model A the wrong way, and neither result decides anything; the rule rests on the reasoning above, as decided.

forward: Every 2026 pick at a neutral site stores neutral_site true and the model version; the page says the home edge was left out. Reported at the season's end beside the back-check, deciding nothing.
